claim_boundaries.primary_technical_claim: a label-blind, bounded, event-and-payload-aware heterogeneous package graph jointly models syntax, dangerous behavior events, parameter payloads, and package context
claim_boundaries.cross_file_relations: retained as part of the package-level graph design, but not claimed as a separately proven encoder or a universally beneficial independent module
claim_boundaries.package_global_param_anchor: retained as a design detail only; S9-I does not authorize it as an independent performance contribution
claim_boundaries.ModernBERT: off-the-shelf auxiliary sequence backbone, not an original architecture
claim_boundaries.fusion: leakage-safe low-variance complementary integration, not a novel fusion algorithm
claim_boundaries.partial_OOD: prefix-defined partial malicious-source shift stress test, not a clean independent Datadog-family or temporal OOD benchmark

baseline_contract.Cerebro: three validation-frozen seed operating points are ready; an earlier one-shot baseline test artifact exists and is reused, not rerun or retuned
baseline_contract.EA4MP: three full-AdaBoost validation runs and three deployment thresholds are frozen; final full-method test metrics remain pending
baseline_contract.Bandit4Mal: deterministic B800-B899 custom-rule policy; exact V2 SHA join and unmatched-row inference only after final authorization
baseline_contract.GuardDog: deterministic any-issue native policy; exact V2 SHA join and unmatched-row inference only after final authorization
baseline_contract.OSSGadget: deterministic any-rule native policy; exact V2 SHA join and unmatched-row inference only after final authorization
